title: Arts
intro: Civil services, psychology, media, law, design and teaching. Tap to open each step.

nodes.label: Admission by marks
nodes.note: Many Karnataka BA colleges admit by Class 12 (PUC) marks. There is no entrance test.

nodes.label: BA (History, Political Science, Economics, Languages)
nodes.note: 3 to 4 years. A base for civil services, teaching, research and policy.

nodes.label: BA Psychology
nodes.note: Then MA or MSc. Clinical psychologists need a recognised clinical qualification and registration.

nodes.label: BJMC / Media Studies
nodes.note: 3 years. Journalism, PR, digital media.

nodes.label: BA LLB
nodes.note: 5 years at a law university.

nodes.label: B.Des
nodes.note: 4 years. Product, communication, interaction and fashion design.

nodes.label: ITEP (BA B.Ed)
nodes.note: 4-year teacher degree.

nodes.label: Liberal Arts degree
nodes.note: 3 to 4 years at FLAME, Ashoka, Azim Premji and similar universities.

nodes.label: B.Ed (after BA)
nodes.note: 2 years after your degree.

nodes.label: Civil servant (IAS, IPS)
nodes.note: Run districts and departments, and shape policy.

nodes.label: Psychologist or counsellor
nodes.note: Help people with learning, work and mental health.

nodes.label: Journalist or media professional
nodes.note: News, content, PR and digital media.

nodes.label: Lawyer
nodes.note: Court work and legal advice. Pass the Bar exam first.

nodes.label: Designer
nodes.note: Product, brand, app or fashion designer.

nodes.label: School teacher
nodes.note: Teach in a school after clearing the teacher tests.

nodes.label: Researcher or professor
nodes.note: Study society, history or language and teach at a college.

nodes.label: MA (master's degree, 2 years)
nodes.note: Needed for lecturer tests. Pick the subject you love.

nodes.label: Karnataka state officer (KAS)
nodes.note: Work as Tahsildar, Assistant Commissioner or in other state posts.

nodes.label: Government officer
nodes.note: Work in tax, audit and other central government offices.

nodes.label: MSW (social work, 2 years)
nodes.note: Master's in social work.

nodes.label: MA Economics, History or Political Science
nodes.note: 2 years. Deeper study of society.

nodes.label: Diplomat (Indian Foreign Service)
nodes.note: Represent India in other countries.

nodes.label: Revenue officer (IRS)
nodes.note: Work on income tax and customs.

nodes.label: Police officer (IPS)
nodes.note: Lead police and keep people safe.

nodes.label: Social media manager
nodes.note: Run pages and campaigns for brands.

nodes.label: Content writer
nodes.note: Write articles, scripts and posts.

nodes.label: Translator or interpreter
nodes.note: Turn one language into another.

nodes.label: Librarian
nodes.note: Look after books and information.

nodes.label: Archaeologist
nodes.note: Study the past from old objects.

nodes.label: Museum curator
nodes.note: Care for exhibits and tell their stories.

nodes.label: Public relations officer
nodes.note: Build a good image for people and firms.

nodes.label: HR executive
nodes.note: Help with hiring and staff matters.

nodes.label: Social worker
nodes.note: Help families and communities in need.

nodes.label: NGO programme manager
nodes.note: Run projects for a non-profit.

nodes.label: CSR officer
nodes.note: Help companies do good for society.

nodes.label: Economist
nodes.note: Study how money and markets work.

nodes.label: Public policy analyst
nodes.note: Study problems and suggest government plans.

nodes.label: Historian
nodes.note: Study and write about the past.

nodes.label: Political analyst
nodes.note: Study politics and elections.

nodes.label: School or career counsellor
nodes.note: Guide students and families.

nodes.label: Clinical psychologist
nodes.note: Help people with mental health needs.

nodes.label: Industrial psychologist
nodes.note: Make workplaces happier and fairer.

nodes.label: News anchor or reporter
nodes.note: Present and report the news.

nodes.label: Media planner
nodes.note: Plan where ads and shows appear.

nodes.label: Filmmaker or video editor
nodes.note: Make films and videos.

nodes.label: Radio jockey
nodes.note: Host shows on the radio.

nodes.label: UX designer
nodes.note: Design how apps feel to use.

nodes.label: Illustrator
nodes.note: Draw pictures for books and brands.

nodes.label: School principal
nodes.note: Lead a school after years of teaching.

nodes.label: Primary school teacher
nodes.note: Teach young children.
